name: – Pierre Pimpie – § 15 – Am 6
title: REPORT on the implementation of the VAT reverse-charge mechanism
part_text: 15. Stresses that the RCM must remain an exceptional derogation and not replace the need for a broader VAT reform; calls on the Commission to present a roadmap for a comprehensive and coherent VAT framework, aimed at closing loopholes that enable large-scale VAT fraud, stronger administrative cooperation and effective enforcement of measures to prevent cross-border VAT fraud;
